personal.title: Compliment chain
personal.description: Give three different people a sincere compliment within ten minutes. Proof: the names of the three people, and a player who saw at least one.

personal.title: Word of the night
personal.description: Slip the word "marmalade" into a conversation so naturally that nobody questions it. Proof: who you said it to and what they replied.

personal.title: Mirror, mirror
personal.description: Get a friend to copy your pose in a photo without telling them why. Proof: the photo.

personal.title: High-five trail
personal.description: Get five different people to high-five you, one after another. Proof: a comment naming all five.

personal.title: Surprise order
personal.description: Let a friend choose your next drink (within reason) and drink it happily. Proof: a photo of the drink and who picked it.

personal.title: Mystery accent
personal.description: Speak in a silly accent for a full conversation until someone asks about it. Proof: who asked, and a player who heard it.

personal.title: Photo director
personal.description: Organise a group photo where everybody is making the same face. Proof: the photo.

personal.title: Dad joke delivery
personal.description: Tell a terrible joke and get a proper groan out of someone. Proof: the joke, and who groaned.

personal.title: Call me Dave
personal.description: Introduce yourself to a friend of a friend by a made-up name and keep it up for ten minutes. Proof: the name you used and who you told.

personal.title: Make a toast
personal.description: Get a small group to raise their glasses for a toast you made up on the spot. Proof: a photo, or a player who joined in.

personal.title: Hat trick
personal.description: Persuade someone to wear something silly of yours for five minutes. Proof: a photo of them wearing it.

personal.title: Fun fact
personal.description: Share a believable made-up fun fact and get someone to say "really?". Proof: the fact, and who fell for it.

global.title: Best headwear
global.description: Find or make the best hat from whatever is nearby and wear it. Everyone votes for their favourite.

global.title: Selfie stack
global.description: Take a selfie with as many different players in it as you can fit. The biggest crowd wins the vote.

global.title: Toast of the night
global.description: Deliver the most heartfelt or ridiculous toast to the room. Everyone votes for the best.

global.title: Signature move
global.description: Invent a dance move, name it, and teach it to at least two other players. The most catching move wins.

global.title: Odd object
global.description: Find the strangest object you can borrow without taking it from anyone who minds, and show it off. The oddest wins.
